prose: Ben Thompson's Stratechery update covers Apple's smarter-than-expected approach to the smart home - leaning into partner integration rather than owning everything - and turns to what Amazon should do about AI agents, in the context of emerging agent standards. Basis: the article is subscriber-only; only the free teaser and subscription pitch were retrievable, so this summary reflects the visible framing rather than the full analysis.
highlights: Apple's home strategy: integration with partners over building everything itself.
Thompson turns to what Amazon should do about AI agents and agent standards.
